description: This is a main activity Java source file for an Android Wearable app implementing delayed confirmation functionality, handling user interactions, GoogleApiClient connection, and inter-device communication.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Handles user interactions with delayed confirmation timer, manages GoogleApiClient connection, and communicates with companion device.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and builds GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient if not already connected.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes capability listener and disconnects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onStartTimer
methods.description: Starts the delayed confirmation timer when user presses 'Start Timer'.

methods.name: onTimerSelected
methods.description: Handles timer selection event, shows notification, and sends message to companion device.

methods.name: onTimerFinished
methods.description: Handles timer completion event, shows notification, and sends message to companion device.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect to GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: sendMessageToCompanion
methods.description: Sends a message to the companion device via Wearable MessageApi.

methods.name: getSendMessageResultCallback
methods.description: Provides callback logic for message send result, logging success or failure.

methods.name: setupConfirmationHandlerNode
methods.description: Sets up capability listener and retrieves current capability info for confirmation handler.

methods.name: updateConfirmationCapability
methods.description: Updates internal node reference based on available capability info.

methods.name: pickBestNode
methods.description: Selects the most suitable node from connected nodes, preferring nearby nodes.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient is connected, triggers setup of confirmation handler node.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of API client connection.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Updates confirmation node when capability info changes.
